hero.lead: Atlanta to Miami is under two hours nonstop, with flights from early morning to late evening. Fly in Monday, get 20 porcelain veneers made in our own lab, fly home Thursday with a 5-year warranty in writing.
hero.alt: The Atlanta skyline from a plane window just after takeoff at sunrise
hero.caption: ATL → MIA · about 1 h 55 min nonstop · 15 minutes from the airport to the clinic

intro: Atlanta is one of the cities we see most: nonstop flights to MIA all day, about 1 hour 55 minutes in the air, and you land 15 minutes from our door. The treatment is [porcelain veneers](/porcelain-veneers-miami) on the teeth you show, or the 20-veneer [Smile Design](/smile-design-miami) at {price}, made in the [lab one floor above your doctor](/custom-lab). Hotels, airport and what to pack are on the [out-of-state patients page](/out-of-state-patients).

gettingHere.title: Getting from Atlanta to the clinic
gettingHere.aside: General guidance from the clinic. Check times and carriers with the airline when you book; we do not sell flights.
gettingHere.alt: Miami from the plane window on approach to Miami International Airport

items.d: About 1 h 55 min nonstop, ATL to MIA. Plan on two and a half hours door to gate.
Delta, American and Southwest, nonstop from early morning to late evening.
15 minutes by Uber or Lyft. We text you the pickup spot before you land.
About 660 miles down I-75, nine to ten hours. Most Atlanta patients fly.

itinerary.title: A sample Monday-to-Thursday from Atlanta
itinerary.intro: Times are examples to show how the week fits. Pick any flight that lands by mid-morning Monday and leaves after 4 pm Thursday, and the schedule holds.

days.t: Early flight, Visit 1 by late morning
days.d: Land, rideshare to the clinic. Exam, scans and the design preview you approve.
days.time: Visit 1 about 11:00 am to 1:00 pm. Check in at the hotel after.

days.d: Minimal preparation, then temporaries in the shape you approved. Afternoon free.

days.t: Free day while the lab finishes
days.d: Your veneers are finished by hand in the lab upstairs. No visit.
days.time: No visit. Beach, Wynwood or rest.

days.t: Delivery, then the evening flight home
days.d: Shade check, bonding, bite adjusted, warranty in writing. Then the airport.
days.time: Visit 3 about 9:00 am to 11:00 am. Fly MIA–ATL from about 4:00 pm, home by 7:00 pm.

itinerary.note: Prefer not to rush Monday? Fly in Sunday evening; the extra hotel night is the only difference.

cost.title: What it costs to come from Atlanta
cost.body: Treatment is priced from the [published packages](/veneers-cost-miami) and confirmed in writing before you book. Travel is yours to book; we do not quote fares because they change daily.

lines.label: Smile Design, 20 porcelain veneers
lines.note: Preview, cleaning, X-rays and the {warrantyYears}-year written warranty included

lines.label: Hotel, three or four nights
lines.note: Hilton and Marriott within 10 minutes; you book directly from the list we send

lines.label: Flights ATL–MIA and rides
lines.note: Not included. Rides from the airport and to each visit are short

cost.footnote: Monthly plans through six financing partners with a soft credit check. Your coordinator helps with the application before you book flights.

items.q: Can I fly home to Atlanta the same day as delivery?
items.a: Yes. Delivery on Thursday takes about two hours in the morning, and the bonding is final when you leave the chair. Book a flight after 4 pm so there is no rush, eat a soft lunch, and you are home in Atlanta by dinner.

items.q: Should I fly in Sunday or Monday morning?
items.a: Either works. A 7 am flight from ATL lands in time for an 11 am Visit 1. If early flights are not for you, come Sunday evening; the only difference is one more hotel night.

items.q: What if something needs adjusting once I am back in Atlanta?
items.a: We do a video check-in two weeks after delivery. Small adjustments are covered by the {warrantyYears}-year warranty and can be done by any dentist near you; anything larger, we bring you back.

items.q: Can I keep seeing my Atlanta dentist for cleanings?
items.a: Yes, and you should. Veneers are cleaned like natural teeth. Tell your hygienist you have zirconia veneers so they use a non-abrasive polish, and keep your six-month visits.

items.q: How do I compare your price with quotes I have in Atlanta?
items.a: Ask every clinic for the same five things in writing: the material, the number of teeth, veneer or crown per tooth, the total, and the warranty. Ours are published and in your estimate. Then add two flights and three hotel nights to ours and compare the totals.

items.q: Do I need a rental car in Miami?
items.a: No. The clinic is 15 minutes from MIA and the partner hotels are within 10 minutes of the clinic, so Uber or Lyft covers the whole week. We text you the pickup details for each visit the evening before.
